status: DRAFT — AI-proposed draft rule expectations. NOT human labels, NOT a gold standard. Pending E + a second human reviewer.
primary_topic_contract: primary_topic = first REQUESTED topic among matched; same-field anchor/QC pairing may cross clauses within a field (AM-40)
fixture_key_note: M/I/A prefixes are HISTORICAL IDENTIFIERS only. They are not classification inputs and not authoritative topics. They exist so that documents and tests can refer to records readably; the ID (o5:...) is the record's identity.
id_scheme: o5:<first 32 hex of sha256(canon(title) + U+001F + canon(source) + U+001F + canonical_url + U+001F + timestamp_iso)>. canon = NFKC, casefold, collapse whitespace, strip. URL absent => ''. Canonical URL = lowercase scheme+host, no default port, no trailing slash, query+fragment dropped. Timestamp ISO at second precision. U+001F separator (AM-27).
source_annotation: ALL sources are synthetic (FixtureWire A..L, SyntheticWire A..H). No real outlet is attributed any article. Titles/summaries are fabricated examples and must not be cited as reporting.

selector_contract.in_memory: published_at is an aware datetime (UTC) or null. Loader converts serialized RFC3339 strings to datetimes BEFORE the selector. fixture_key is stripped before selection.
selector_contract.serialized: this file stores RFC3339 strings. url is always null (no fabricated links).
selector_contract.raw_removed: AM-13: no raw object; selected copies preserve the supplied business fields.

window.note: Selector inclusive (AM-01/AM-25). Adapter: start_at = 00:00 of start_date UTC; end_at = (end_date + 1 day) - 1 microsecond.

review_basis: Member F correction applied: I04's summary contains Fed's + tightening; tokenizer maps Fed's -> [fed, s], so I04 matches MONETARY_POLICY and INFLATION (primary MONETARY_POLICY). M02's summary European Central Bank + rate => R1 fires (MP); easing inflation => R2 QC easing but no separate INFLATION topic? see witness. Labels AI-proposed; human approval Pending.
matching_scope: Anchor and QC must be in the same field (title or summary); pairing MAY cross clause boundaries within that field; it MUST NOT cross fields.
percent_tokenization: NFKC->casefold; every % becomes its own token. Trailing/leading '.' and '-' are boundary punctuation and are stripped from tokens. Examples: 3.1% -> [3.1, %]; % -> [%]; percent -> [percent]; tightening. -> [tightening].
